minimal-durable-cas.scope: Existing public CAS plus exact verification of two64byte unique artifacts per consumer. Open outside timer. No event append, context preparation, writer/layout recheck or durability bypass. Six fresh processes;2warmups30samples each. Not paired qualification or a physical lower-bound proof.

sqlite-cas.scope: Scratch-only alternate bounded artifact backend, not existing CAS format or production-qualified. SQLite FULL commits grouped report bytes; get rehashes exact canonical BLOB. Missing stream/reader-format/rebinding/recovery qualification means this cannot establish implementation or resource acceptance.

sqlite-cas-fullfsync.scope: Scratch-only alternate bounded artifact backend, not existing CAS format or production-qualified. SQLite FULL with fullfsync=ON and checkpoint_fullfsync=ON commits grouped report bytes; get rehashes exact canonical BLOB. Missing stream/reader-format/rebinding/recovery qualification means this cannot establish implementation or resource acceptance.

decisions.next: Specify and test bounded group synchronization behind the artifact-store boundary with explicit format/readers/recovery/rollback. Do not activate or claim compatibility from these prototypes.

limits: These are diagnostic prototypes, not preregistered qualification cohorts.
All comparison workers use4KiB and sampled workloads only;no12KiB,changed-source,power-loss,multiprocess or installed acceptance.
One local knowledge query overlapped the FULL-only SQLite diagnostic;retain the observations, do not claim isolated timing. It is independently ineligible because durability differs.
The minimal64byte CAS probe omits initialization,context,writer/path checks and event appends and proves no universal lower bound.
SQLite prototypes retain bounded report BLOBs only and omit production stream/format negotiation/rebinding/recovery contracts.
fullfsync pragma readback and documented VFS behavior are not a power-loss or syscall-trace certification.
